pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and CB2 receptor with EC50 values of 0.52 nM and 0.88 nM respectively.

uses.text: ADB-PINACA is a cannabinoid designer drug that is an ingredient in some synthetic cannabis products.

sideEffects.text: ADB-PINACA has been linked to multiple hospitalizations and deaths due to its use.

summaryZh: ADB-PINACA是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C19H28N4O2，屬於具有大麻素結構的狡詐家藥物，常溫常壓下為白色固體，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

fact.en: It contains tert-leucine, an amino acid that does not occur in nature. Several of the strongest synthetic cannabinoids use such unnatural amino acids as building blocks.
fact.zh: 它含有三級白胺酸（tert-leucine），這是一種自然界不存在的胺基酸。效力最強的幾種合成大麻素都用這類非天然胺基酸作為組件。
fact.zhHans: 它含有三级白胺酸（tert-leucine），这是一种自然界不存在的胺基酸。效力最强的几种合成大麻素都用这类非天然胺基酸作为组件。
